claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised himself as the retired champion pugilist of the world.
claims.excerpt:
Retired Champion Pugil@st of the World, 619
Market street.

claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised a free concert every evening at his place at 619 Market Street, St. Louis.
claims.excerpt: Market street. Free concert every evening.

notes: The hint calls this a saloon, but the advertisement does not say saloon, so the kind is business. The advertisement is an ad for a free concert at Allen's address.
